Ecotoxicology

- I spent the morning reviewing Section I and II of The Principles of
  Ecotoxicology.

  - Section I: Pollutants and Their Fate in Ecosystems. There are five
    chapters that introduce organic versus inorganic pollutants, their
    route into ecosystems, and their distribution within those
    ecosystems. Most of this was review. I skipped the radioactive
    isotopes since they are not applicable.

  - Section II: Effects of Pollutants on Individual Organisms. There are
    six chapters that cover testing, effects, and drills down on
    biomarker types, responses and their role in ecosystem assessment.
    Most of this was review, but I did flag spaces where I needed to
    reinforce my understanding.
